title: thalictrum minus subsp. caffrum
intro: Thalictrum minus subsp. caffrum, commonly known as Dwarf Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, wounds, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Meadow Rue include its ability to act as a diuretic, expectorant, and emmenagogue, making it useful in treating conditions like coughs, colds, and menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of Thalictrum minus subsp. caffrum include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
